name: Aigan Iinchou ~Doukyuusei wa Nikudorei~
original_name: 愛玩委員長～同級生は肉奴隷～
source:
Yoji is a transfered student. He is attracted by Miyuki, a class president. She shows him around the school after school and suddenly she induces him to have a sex with her. After that his classmates tell him that she is a "sexual slave" and he is appointed as her trainer.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305031455/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003059]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
小原洋二是一名转学生，很快便被班长筱原美雪吸引。放学后，美雪带他参观学校，却突然诱使他与自己做爱。事后，同学们告诉洋二，美雪其实是一个“性奴”，而他则被指定为她的调教师。

[内容取自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305031455/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003059]Eroge Shop[/url]]
